messages:
Marina: PR ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5123 — does schema bundle reorg + compact examples for function/tool calling. Two quick asks: spot the JSON schema typo (I think a missing comma in structured-output example) and patch the broken anchor for \"tool-calling#examples\". Trying to land today.

Devin: taking schema lint pass now. will run jsonschema-cli and report errs.

schema-lint-bot: [auto] run jsonschema-cli validate ./docs/structured-output/example.json -> ERROR: line 24: unexpected token ',' (trailing comma?) — file: docs/structured-output/example.json

Sam: I can do SDK snippets — will update python & ts examples to match new schema shape. ping @Marina for desired shape (compact vs verbose).

Jess: I'll sweep links and update that anchor. also will run linkcheck CI.

Marina: thanks! For the schema change we decided to prefer the \"envelope\" field (compact envelope). If it's helpful, here's a suggested replacement snippet to drop in: 

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "envelope": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "tool": { "type": "string" },
        "output": { "type": "object" }
      },
      "required": ["tool","output"]
    }
  },
  "required": ["envelope"]
}
```

Devin: looks good, but validator flagged a trailing comma on line 24 earlier. Marina's snippet fine. I'll commit a one-line fix and re-run.

Sam: heads-up — Python SDK example needs `client.invoke(..., response_format=\"envelope\")` change. I'll open a tiny PR to sync snippets.

Jess: fixed anchor: docs/faq#tool-calling -> docs/tooling/calling#examples — pushed redirect in markdown. linkcheck passed locally.

schema-lint-bot: [auto] re-run -> OK: no schema errors.

Marina: awesome. final checklist before merge: (1) update sdk snippets PRs linked in main PR, (2) add a short migration note in CHANGELOG under \"docs\", (3) run a docs small smoke deploy (staging). Anyone want to own smoke deploy?

Sam: I can kick off staging deploy after my PR is merged.

Devin: merged schema fix -> commit 0f3a1b. re-running CI.

Jess: did link redirect, also fixed two typos in examples.md (s/recieve/receive/ and s/arguemnt/argument/).

Marina: thanks all :tada: planning to merge after staging smoke is green. leaving this thread open for any late finds.
